title: Puzzle2d Live Peer Sync
description: Restore commit-93 canvas speed while keeping commit-94 live cross-pane node-move/delete sync, by replacing per-frame full-scene WASM re-push on peer panes with lightweight incremental per-node position update in Rust/WASM BoardSession.
summary: Fixed slow selection initiate/finalize: area-select end no longer calls markSceneDescriptorDirty unless wasmDeferHadStructuralMutation during defer; fast path pushes selection/preselect via setSelectionIdsJsonSilent; coalesced select React emit per RAF; pointer-up camera emit only when camera moved. 96 vitest pass.
